description: This script generates MCP tools from OpenAPI specifications, including functions to load specs, extract parameters, build input schemas, create tool functions dynamically, and register tools based on OpenAPI paths and operations.

methods.name: load_openapi_spec
methods.description: Load OpenAPI specification from JSON file.

methods.name: get_base_url
methods.description: Extract base URL from OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: extract_parameters
methods.description: Extract parameter names from OpenAPI operation.

methods.name: build_input_schema
methods.description: Build MCP input schema from OpenAPI operation.

methods.name: create_tool_function
methods.description: Create a dynamic async function to call an API operation based on OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: register_tools_from_openapi
methods.description: Register MCP tools from OpenAPI specification by generating functions and registering them.
